annotations.title: Start a new App Store version

description: Apple takes text and screenshot changes only on a version being prepared. This creates the next one (e.g. 1.2.0), copying the last version's text and screenshots. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
